_about: Dimethyl carbonate (1) + Methyl isobutyl ketone (2): total pressures against temperature, 351.22-383.6 K, at set liquid compositions. Rows: temperature in K, liquid mole fraction of dimethyl carbonate, pressure in kPa, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record.

source.citation: H. Matsuda, H. Takahara, S. Fujino, D. Constantinescu, K. Kurihara, K. Tochigi, K. Ochi, J. Gmehling, Selection of entrainers for the separation of the binary azeotropic system methanol + dimethyl carbonate by extractive distillation, Fluid Phase Equilib. 310 (2011) 166-181
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 10. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. No isotherm of the set has its own pure-component pressures, so the fit uses the vapour pressures of the component records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
